description: Declarative tweaks. Every entry carries both the applied state and the state to restore, so nothing here is one way.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows telemetry
tweaks.description: Sets the diagnostic data level to Security and stops the connected user experiences service. On Home and Pro the policy caps collection rather than removing it entirely.

tweaks.name: Disable the advertising ID
tweaks.description: Stops applications from using a per user identifier to correlate advertising across apps.

tweaks.name: Disable activity history
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from recording the timeline of opened applications and documents, and from uploading it to a Microsoft account.

tweaks.name: Disable suggested apps and consumer features
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from silently installing promoted applications and from showing suggestions in the Start menu.

tweaks.name: Remove web results from the Start menu search
tweaks.description: Keeps the Start menu search local. Every keystroke otherwise reaches Bing.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Copilot
tweaks.description: Removes the Copilot entry point from the taskbar and the shell.

tweaks.name: Disable Recall snapshots
tweaks.description: Prevents the AI data analysis feature from capturing periodic screenshots of the session. Only relevant on Copilot+ hardware.

tweaks.name: Deny location access to applications
tweaks.description: Blocks the location capability globally. Turn it back on before troubleshooting anything that legitimately needs geolocation.

tweaks.name: Download updates from Microsoft only, not from other PCs
tweaks.description: Sets Delivery Optimization to HTTP only: updates and Store apps come from Microsoft or the configured source, and this machine neither downloads from nor uploads to other computers. Useful on a metered link, or where peer traffic between machines is not wanted.

tweaks.name: Show file extensions
tweaks.description: Makes invoice.pdf.exe visible for what it is. This is a security control as much as a convenience.

tweaks.name: Show hidden files
tweaks.description: Displays hidden items in Explorer.

tweaks.name: Restore the classic context menu (Windows 11)
tweaks.description: Removes the compact Windows 11 right click menu and the extra click it adds to every shell extension. Explorer must restart for the change to appear.

tweaks.name: Align the taskbar to the left
tweaks.description: Moves the Windows 11 taskbar icons back to the left edge.

tweaks.name: Show seconds in the taskbar clock
tweaks.description: Useful when correlating a user report with a log timestamp.

tweaks.name: Enable the dark theme
tweaks.description: Switches applications and the shell to the dark theme.

tweaks.name: Verbose logon messages
tweaks.description: Replaces 'Please wait' with the actual step being executed. The fastest way to see which group policy extension is hanging a logon.

tweaks.name: Disable widgets and news
tweaks.description: Removes the widgets board and its background feed refresh, through the machine policy. The taskbar button itself is protected by Windows 11 and can only be hidden from taskbar settings.

tweaks.name: Turn Num Lock on at start up
tweaks.description: Starts with the numeric keypad on, at the sign-in screen and in the session of this user, so a PIN or a password with digits types what it should. Fast start-up restores the keyboard state of the last session instead: if Num Lock still starts off, disable fast start-up too.

tweaks.name: Disable the Sticky Keys, Filter Keys and Toggle Keys shortcuts
tweaks.description: Stops pressing Shift five times, or holding the right Shift key, from turning on an accessibility feature in the middle of a game or a typing session. The features stay available from Settings. Takes effect at the next sign-in.

tweaks.name: Open Explorer on This PC
tweaks.description: Opens File Explorer on the drives rather than on Home and its recent files, which is also where a support call wants to start.

tweaks.name: Add End task to the taskbar menu (Windows 11)
tweaks.description: Adds End task to the right click menu of a taskbar button, which closes a frozen application without opening Task Manager. The same switch as Settings, System, For developers.

tweaks.name: Enable clipboard history
tweaks.description: Keeps the last copied items, opened with Windows+V. Passwords copied from a manager are kept there too until cleared, so leave it off on a shared machine.

tweaks.name: Show the full path in the Explorer title bar
tweaks.description: Shows C:\Users\name\Documents rather than Documents, so the folder open is never ambiguous in a screenshot or on a shared screen.

tweaks.name: Hide the Task View button
tweaks.description: Removes the Task View button from the taskbar. Windows+Tab still opens it.

tweaks.name: Disable fast start-up
tweaks.description: Makes a shutdown a real shutdown. Fast start-up hibernates the kernel session, which is why a driver problem survives a shutdown but not a restart. Disable it on any machine you are troubleshooting or dual booting.

tweaks.name: Stop applications running in the background
tweaks.description: Prevents Store applications from running when not in the foreground. Notifications from those applications stop as well.

tweaks.name: Disable SysMain (Superfetch)
tweaks.description: Worth doing on an SSD where the prefetching gains nothing and the service can generate constant disk activity. Leave it enabled on a mechanical drive.

tweaks.name: Enable paths longer than 260 characters
tweaks.description: Removes the MAX_PATH limit for applications that declare support for it. Ends a whole class of backup and copy failures on deep folder trees.

tweaks.name: Disable hibernation
tweaks.description: Reclaims a hiberfil.sys the size of installed memory: Windows removes the file at the next restart. Fast start-up relies on hibernation, so it stops too. Do not apply on a laptop that relies on hibernate for battery preservation.

tweaks.name: Disable transparency effects
tweaks.description: Turns off the blur behind the Start menu, the taskbar and windows. It saves graphics work on a low end machine or in a remote session, and makes text easier to read.

tweaks.name: Enable Game Mode
tweaks.description: Prioritises the foreground game for CPU and GPU scheduling.

tweaks.name: Enable hardware accelerated GPU scheduling
tweaks.description: Lets the GPU manage its own frame queue. Requires a supported adapter and a recent driver; revert it if you see display instability.

tweaks.name: Disable the Game Bar and background recording
tweaks.description: Removes the capture overlay and the background recording that costs frames.

tweaks.name: Disable mouse acceleration (Enhance pointer precision)
tweaks.description: Makes the pointer move the same distance for the same hand movement, whatever the speed, which is what aiming and precise drawing need. Takes effect at the next sign-in.

tweaks.name: Disable AutoRun on every drive type
tweaks.description: A USB stick found in a car park should not be able to start anything when it is plugged in.

tweaks.name: Disable LLMNR
tweaks.description: Link local multicast name resolution is what Responder abuses to answer failed DNS lookups and capture NTLM hashes. Nothing in a network with working DNS needs it.

tweaks.name: Enable PowerShell script block logging
tweaks.description: Records de-obfuscated PowerShell in the event log. This is the single most useful piece of telemetry when investigating an incident on Windows.

tweaks.name: Disable Remote Assistance
tweaks.description: Closes an inbound remote control path that most estates never use and rarely monitor.

tweaks.name: Always prompt for elevation on the secure desktop
tweaks.description: Raises UAC to prompt for consent on the secure desktop, which cannot be driven by another process on the interactive desktop.

tweaks.name: Disable the Remote Registry service
tweaks.description: Removes remote registry read and write. Some inventory agents rely on it, so check before applying on a managed estate.

tweaks.name: Disable the print spooler
tweaks.description: The PrintNightmare mitigation for servers that do not print. Applying this on a workstation removes all printing, including to PDF.

tweaks.name: Enable Remote Desktop with NLA required
tweaks.description: Opens RDP and requires Network Level Authentication. Only do this on a machine reachable from a management network, never from the internet.

tweaks.name: Disable Storage Sense
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from deleting files in the recycle bin and the downloads folder on its own schedule.

tweaks.name: Stop OneDrive starting with Windows
tweaks.description: Leaves OneDrive installed and usable but removes it from the logon sequence.

tweaks.name: Disable the start-up sound
tweaks.description: Silences the Windows boot chime.

tweaks.name: Stay on the blue screen instead of restarting
tweaks.description: Keeps a crash on screen until someone reads the stop code and the driver named, instead of restarting at once. Only for a machine being troubleshot with someone in front of it: a server or an unattended PC would stay down.

tweaks.name: Do not install drivers through Windows Update
tweaks.description: Stops Windows Update from replacing drivers, for a machine whose drivers come from the manufacturer or are pinned for a reason, such as a graphics or storage driver a generic one breaks. Driver updates then have to be installed by hand.

tweaks.name: Do not restart for updates while someone is signed in
tweaks.description: Keeps Windows Update from restarting the machine on its own while a user is signed in, so an overnight job or an open document is not lost. Updates wait for a restart someone chooses, so check the pending reboot report now and then.

tweaks.name: Never keep WDigest sign-in passwords in memory
tweaks.description: Makes sure Windows never keeps sign-in passwords in clear text in memory for the WDigest protocol. It is already the behaviour of Windows 8.1 and later while the value is absent; the security baselines ask for it explicitly, and the Security audit flags a 1, the first thing credential theft tools set. Applies to sign-ins from then on.

tweaks.name: Remove SMBv1
tweaks.description: Removes the SMBv1 client and server, the protocol WannaCry and NotPetya spread over. New installations of Windows 10 1709 and later leave it out already; only a very old NAS, printer or scanner still needs it, and it stops reaching this machine.

tweaks.name: Remove the PowerShell 2.0 engine
tweaks.description: Removes the Windows PowerShell 2.0 engine, which has neither script block logging nor AMSI, and is what an attacker asks for with powershell -version 2 to run unseen. Recent builds of Windows 11 no longer include it, and the tweak then shows as applied.

tweaks.name: Stop resolving NetBIOS names by broadcast
tweaks.description: Sets NetBIOS over TCP/IP to point-to-point (P-node), so another machine on the network cannot answer for a name it does not own and collect the sign-in hashes sent to it, the attack Responder automates. Names still resolve through DNS, and through WINS where there is one. Recommended by the Microsoft security baseline and CIS.

tweaks.name: Block .vbs and .js scripts (Windows Script Host)
tweaks.description: Stops wscript and cscript running .vbs and .js files, the format most malicious e-mail attachments and downloaded droppers use. Logon scripts and old tools written in VBScript stop too: check what a domain pushes before applying it on a managed machine.

tweaks.name: Block potentially unwanted applications (Defender)
tweaks.description: Has Microsoft Defender Antivirus block potentially unwanted applications: bundled adware, browser hijackers, cryptocurrency miners and the installers that add them. No effect while another antivirus is the active one.

tweaks.name: Record every program started, with its command line
tweaks.description: Turns on process creation auditing and adds the command line to it, as event 4688 in the Security log: what an investigation needs to see what ran. Anyone allowed to read the Security log can read those command lines, including a password someone typed on one.

tweaks.name: Keep 1 GB of Security log
tweaks.description: Raises the Security log from its 20 MB default to 1 GB, so the sign-ins and program starts of the last days are still there when an incident is noticed. The security baselines ask for at least 196,608 KB.

tweaks.name: Keep blue screen memory dumps when disk space is low
tweaks.description: Keeps the memory dump written after a blue screen even when free disk space is low, where Windows otherwise removes it to reclaim space, so the crash can still be analysed. The small dumps in the Minidump folder are kept either way.

tweaks.name: Add Windows Sandbox
tweaks.description: Adds Windows Sandbox: a disposable, isolated desktop to open a suspicious file or try an installer in, wiped when it is closed. Pro, Enterprise and Education only, with virtualisation turned on in the firmware.

tweaks.name: Turn on the Windows Subsystem for Linux
tweaks.description: Turns on the Windows Subsystem for Linux and the virtual machine platform it runs on. After the restart, wsl --install -d Ubuntu installs a distribution. Reverting turns the virtual machine platform off as well, which Docker Desktop and other tools may also use.

tweaks.name: Install the OpenSSH server
tweaks.description: Installs the OpenSSH server from Windows Update and sets it to start with Windows, so the machine can be reached with ssh and scp. Installation opens port 22 in the firewall: restrict that rule to the networks it should answer on.

tweaks.name: Add the telnet client
tweaks.description: Adds the telnet client, still the quickest way to see whether a TCP port answers, or to talk to a switch console or an SMTP server by hand.

tweaks.name: Hide recommendations and recent files in Start (Windows 11)
tweaks.description: Turns off the recommended tips, shortcuts and new apps in the Windows 11 Start menu, and the recently opened files it lists, which also appear in jump lists and File Explorer.

tweaks.name: Remove tips and promotions from the lock screen
tweaks.description: Removes the fun facts, tips and promotions drawn over the lock screen picture.

tweaks.name: Hide Gallery in File Explorer (Windows 11)
tweaks.description: Removes Gallery from the File Explorer navigation pane. Takes effect in the next File Explorer window.

tweaks.name: Stop Microsoft Edge running in the background
tweaks.description: Stops Microsoft Edge starting processes at sign-in (startup boost) and running on after its last window is closed. Edge opens a little slower the first time, and edge://settings shows the settings as managed by your organization.

tweaks.name: Send no Microsoft 365 Apps diagnostic data
tweaks.description: Sets the diagnostic data level of Word, Excel, Outlook and the other Microsoft 365 Apps to Neither, for this account. The required service data the connected features need is still sent, as Microsoft documents. Version 1904 and later.
